== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Fury]] that uses the [[Gaze of Fury (attack)|Gaze of Fury]] attack skill. 
* Can target and destroy enemy spirits as well.
** This is notably useful in [[Sunjiang District]] in [[Factions]], and in the [[Domain of Anguish]] when facing [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] 
* Consider using with [[Destruction]], [[Life]], and [[Restoration]].
* Use on spirits that will expire soon, and spirits that will die soon, notably from their own effect, such as [[Agony]]. 
* Can be recast on an already created Spirit of Fury, allowing one to recycle the spirit indefinitely.
{{anomaly|Can be used on any target, not just spirits; can also be cast without a target. If the target is not an enemy spirit, it will destroy the spirit [[spirit range|closest to the target]]. If cast without a target, it will destroy the spirit closest to the caster.}}
{{anomaly|Using this skill while targeting an ally (including spirits) will stop [[Health regeneration#Automatic regeneration|automatic health regeneration]].}}
{{bug|If multiple spirits occupy exactly the same spot, using Gaze of Fury on one of them may destroy one of the others instead.}}
